 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Despite a disappointing and largely unexpected loss at Fresno State last week, Oregon State football still has a lot within its reach with four games left in the regular season, including a Pac-12 Conference championship.
 The Beavers (5-3, 3-1) will look to rebound as they host offensive power Texas State (4-4, 2-2) at 7:30 p.m. Nov. 7 at Reser Stadium in Corvallis. It's the first-ever meeting between the two programs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Bobcats are coming off a 46-45 loss at Pac-12 leader Boise State after trailing 28-3 at halftime. Texas State then scored 36 straight points to lead by 11 midway through the fourth quarter before eventually losing.
 The Statesman Journal will have updates and highlights from Saturday's Texas State at Oregon State game. Come back to follow along.

 Oregon State vs. Texas State updates, score, highlights, analysis
 This section will be updated when the game begins. 
 Oregon State a home favorite
 About an hour before kickoff in Corvallis, the oddsmakers have the Beavers as a 5.5-point favorite against Texas State.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Lots of points are expected, as the over/under total is 71.5 points.
 Odds courtesy of BetMGM as of Saturday, Nov. 7. 
 Beavers 'resetting' after loss to Fresno State
 Oregon State football was a storming cloud of momentum before its 38-22 loss to Fresno State last week.
 The Beavers (5-3) were on a five-game win streak and went up against a Bulldogs team in a night game on the road — facing a defense that disrupted rhythm, forced errors and thrived in the uncomfortable. Fresno State's offense clicked on all cylinders, and in the blink of an eye talks of Oregon State's Pac-12 championship and College Football Playoff bid seemed to fade.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But Oregon State has the opportunity to gain that momentum back.
 The Beavers host Texas State (4-4) on Nov. 7 at Reser Stadium in Corvallis, fresh off of a week where Texas State lost a 46-45 thriller to top 25-ranked Boise State.

Streaming options include Fubo TV , Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV and DirecTV Stream, all of which carry The CW.
